account: From 15 December 2021 through 30 April 2022, an academic medical center and a community hospital in Taiwan tested alerts from an AI analysis of electrocardiograms (ECGs). The trial involved 39 physicians and 15,965 patients. Patients were randomly assigned to AI-assisted care or usual care. A convolutional neural network assessed their ECGs and sent high-risk alerts to physicians, who selected further assessment and treatment. Ninety-day all-cause mortality, the primary endpoint, was 3.6% versus 4.3%, respectively: hazard ratio 0.83, with a 95% confidence interval of 0.70–0.99. The prespecified high-risk subgroup had a hazard ratio of 0.69 (0.53–0.90). The research team published these results in Nature Medicine on 29 April 2024. On 11 June 2025 the same team published an economic analysis of the trial in npj Digital Medicine. In a systematic review published on 24 September 2025 in JACC: Advances, researchers at Sheba Medical Center, with no tie to the Taiwanese team, included the trial among randomized trials of cardiovascular AI and restated its 90-day mortality result. They judged that mortality gains across these trials were modest or limited to subgroups. Longer-term survival and generalizability to other health systems remain uncertain.

fields.account: From 15 December 2021 through 30 April 2022, an academic medical center and a community hospital in Taiwan tested alerts from an AI analysis of electrocardiograms (ECGs). The trial involved 39 physicians and 15,965 patients. Patients were randomly assigned to AI-assisted care or usual care. A convolutional neural network assessed their ECGs and sent high-risk alerts to physicians, who selected further assessment and treatment. Ninety-day all-cause mortality, the primary endpoint, was 3.6% versus 4.3%, respectively: hazard ratio 0.83, with a 95% confidence interval of 0.70–0.99. The prespecified high-risk subgroup had a hazard ratio of 0.69 (0.53–0.90). The research team published these results in Nature Medicine on 29 April 2024. On 11 June 2025 the same team published an economic analysis of the trial in npj Digital Medicine. In a systematic review published on 24 September 2025 in JACC: Advances, researchers at Sheba Medical Center, with no tie to the Taiwanese team, included the trial among randomized trials of cardiovascular AI and restated its 90-day mortality result. They judged that mortality gains across these trials were modest or limited to subgroups. Longer-term survival and generalizability to other health systems remain uncertain.
